series_logline: A delivery rider discovers that every address on their route belongs to a dead resident of the same building, forcing them to unravel a century‑old conspiracy while confronting their own mortality.
promise: A tense, atmospheric mystery that blends supernatural intrigue with a deep exploration of grief, memory, and the hidden histories of urban spaces.

characters.name: Alex Mercer
characters.defining_facts: Late 20s, haunted by a childhood loss, works nights for a courier app
characters.arc: From detached courier to reluctant conduit between the living and the dead, Alex learns to accept mortality and becomes the key to resolving the century‑old mystery.

characters.name: Maya Patel
characters.defining_facts: Mid‑30s, skeptical, driven by a desire for truth, works for a local newspaper
characters.arc: Starts as a cynical reporter chasing a sensational story, discovers the supernatural reality, and ultimately becomes Alex’s confidante and partner in unraveling the conspiracy.

characters.name: Dr. Evelyn Lark
characters.defining_facts: Early 50s, specializes in urban legends, holds key records of the building’s past
characters.arc: Transitions from detached scholar to personally invested guardian of the building’s secrets, revealing the truth about the deaths.

characters.name: Detective Luis Reyes
characters.defining_facts: Late 40s, pragmatic, skeptical of the supernatural, assigned to the cold case unit
characters.arc: Moves from skeptic to believer, uses his investigative skills to protect Alex and help bring closure.

characters.name: The Whisper
characters.defining_facts: Former resident, died in a fire 120 years ago, possesses the ability to influence the living
characters.arc: From vengeful spirit seeking retribution to seeking redemption and closure, ultimately aiding Alex in resolving the cycle of deaths.

characters.name: Officer Chen
characters.defining_facts: Early 30s, supportive, part of the precinct
characters.arc: Provides logistical support and comic relief, grows to respect Alex’s mission.

long_threads.question: Can Alex bring the deceased to peace?
What is the secret of Building 17?

guardrails: Avoid explicit gore or gratuitous violence
Maintain a respectful tone toward death and grieving
